name: [Negative] Banking Option Limitations
description: Users are frustrated that the app only supports limited bank options for US stocks investing, leading to difficulties in account linking, nomination updates, and money transfers.

name: [Negative] US Market Bank Account Restrictions
description: Users report that the app only supports a limited set of private‑sector banks for US market investing, excludes PSU banks, and has raised the minimum investment amount for certain banks. These constraints prevent many customers from opening or funding US stock positions, causing frustration and loss of investment opportunities.
